Supported rules

Thermal links transfer heat to aqueous samples. Tube links connect a vessel → condenser → collector, or fictional stress source → chamber. Wire terminals form DC resistor circuits. Supports connect a stand to a pendulum.

Mixtures: water/dye, dilute strong acid/base with indicator, calcium chloride/carbonate precipitation, and illustrative effervescence. Other mixtures report “not modeled.”

Water phase changes use ideal heat capacities and latent heats; solutions use the same approximation. Smoke, flames, frost, fragments, and blast effects are illustrative. Chamber stress units and failure limits are fictional.
